text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"—A completely locked room, and a cryptic 
dying message left behind! Next week, all 
mysteries will be unraveled...!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I think I figured out who the culprit 
is!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Wait! Do NOT, under aaaaaany 
circumstances, tell me!! I'll figure it 
out myself...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The murder weapon must be that crossbow... 
Ugh, I feel like I'm so close to figuring 
it out...!

Hating to lose, Almond Eye became so 
absorbed in deducing the culprit that she 
stayed up late into the night...
